features.title: Core NVM Installation Script
acceptance: Install script downloads and sets up nvm in ~/.nvm
Supports bash, zsh, and fish shells
Creates proper shell profile entries
Does not exit with non-zero code on successful sourcing

features.title: Node Version Management
acceptance: List available Node.js versions
Install specific Node.js version
Switch between installed versions
Show current version

features.title: Config File Support (.nvmrc, .node-version, package.json)
acceptance: Read .nvmrc for version
Read .node-version for version
Read package.json engines.node for version
Auto-switch version on directory change

features.title: Self-Update Command
acceptance: nvm update command fetches latest version
Preserves installed Node versions
Updates shell profile if needed

features.title: LTS Alias Support (lts/*, lts/hydrogen, lts/iron, etc.)
acceptance: Resolve lts/* to latest LTS version
Resolve named LTS aliases (lithium, krypton, jod, iron, hydrogen, gallium, fermium, erbium, dubnium, carbon, boron, argon)
Works with nvm install, nvm use, and config files (.nvmrc, .node-version, package.json)

features.title: Node.js Releases API Integration
acceptance: nvm ls-remote uses Node.js releases API (index.json) instead of HTML parsing
nvm ls-remote --lts filters LTS versions from API data
More reliable and faster than HTML parsing
Works with nvm install, nvm use, and config files
